The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20 cm across. The food on it is one small orange fruit, probably a mandarin or persimmon, and a pile of almonds.

The orange fruit is about 5 cm across, so it weighs roughly 70 g and carries about 35 kcal.

I count about 30 almonds. At roughly 1.2 g each, that is about 36 g and about 210 kcal.

Together that comes to about 106 g of food and about 245 kcal.
